Orders API test plan

TC-1 Create order

Precondition: authenticated customer.

  1. POST /orders with sku ABC-1 and quantity 2
  2. Expect status 201 and a response body containing id

TC-2 Reject invalid quantity

Precondition: authenticated customer.

  1. POST /orders with sku ABC-1 and quantity 0
  2. Expect status 400 with an error message
